|---|---|

| [github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/mbtcp](mbtcp.md) | Package mbtcp frames Modbus/TCP: it cuts MBAP ADUs out of one direction's reassembled byte stream, survives gaps and garbage with a bounded resync, and decides which endpoint of a connection is the server. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/model](model.md) | Package model holds the events go-modbus-trace produces: connections, transactions with their ADUs and provenance, gaps, resyncs and notes. |
